Package org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla

Class BedrockItemType

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockItemType
public final class BedrockItemType extends Object
A Bedrock item type. Vanilla types are the constants of BedrockItems; a CustomItem (and the item of a CustomBlock) has one too, so both are used alike: 

 ItemData apple = palette.item(BedrockItems.APPLE).toItemData().count(3).build();
 ItemData potion = palette.item(BedrockItems.POTION.variant(5)).toItemData().build();
Items whose variants differ by damage (potions, banners, goat horns, ...) expose them with variant(int) (null if unknown, variantOf(int) makes any): the bundled data has no names for them, so they have no constants of their own.

Referencing a type loads nothing. A vanilla constant the bundled data does not have (deprecated, or a preview item without the preview loaded) is not available and resolves to its fallback, normally minecraft:unknown.

Since:
1.0.0
